card.fact_statement: The FDLR is an ethnic Hutu militia involved in the broader conflict surrounding the 2025 Goma offensive.
card.source_span: the Congolese military has worked with the FDLR, an ethnic Hutu militia whose members had committed the 1994 genocide
aliases: Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda

target_qa_variants.question: กองกำลังติดอาวุธกลุ่มชาติพันธุ์ฮูตูที่เกี่ยวข้องกับความขัดแย้งในวงกว้างซึ่งเกี่ยวเนื่องกับการรุกโกมาในปี 2025 มีชื่อว่าอะไร
target_qa_variants.source_span: the Congolese military has worked with the FDLR, an ethnic Hutu militia whose members had committed the 1994 genocide
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Goma offensive is translated as การรุกโกมา. FDLR is kept as the English acronym since it is the established way to refer to this group in Thai news.

backtranslation_en.question: What is the name of the Hutu ethnic armed group involved in the broader conflict associated with the Goma offensive in 2025?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target-language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer without adding new constraints or changing the core intent.
